name: Murasaki Sumire
source:
One of the Hakkenshi, he holds the mark of 'gratitude' on his body.
The school doctor, he often gives counsel to the students.
For some reason he is an unfortunate person with terrible luck.
He never stops smiling and rarely ever does his calm personality get disturbed.
